provenance.note: Binary goldens match OpenGrokTelemetry.OTLPProtobuf with fixed nowNanos; not a hand-authored JSON summary of field names only.
evidence: The OTLP wire schema comes from opentelemetry-proto, pinned at 0.32.0 in Cargo.lock at BOTH refs (opentelemetry 0.32.0, opentelemetry-otlp 0.32.0, opentelemetry_sdk 0.32.1 are likewise identical), so ExportTraceServiceRequest field numbering, the TraceService/Export RPC path, and the gRPC length-prefixed framing did not move.

git diff 9739c4a2..80dff0a9 -- crates/codegen/xai-grok-telemetry/src/otlp_http.rs => the only change is TLS trust configuration: build_blocking_client gains an extra_ca_pem_files parameter for OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_CERTIFICATE (fail-closed) plus xai_grok_extra_ca root injection. Nothing in the request body encoding changed.
The rest of the telemetry crate's drift (events.rs, external/*, unified_log.rs, session_ctx.rs) is the Mixpanel-style external event stream, not the OTLP span export these goldens capture.

ProtocolFixtures/otlp-export-trace-http.pb and ProtocolFixtures/otlp-export-trace-grpc.bin are byte-identical to the 9739c4a2 capture and are still re-encoded and compared by Tests/OpenGrokTelemetryTests.
